---
title: "About"
---

This site is a personal technical learning notebook — a long-term knowledge base
covering statistics, machine learning, mathematics, data science, experimental
design, and programming.

It is built gradually, usually one or two topics at a time, and is intended as a
calm, organised reference rather than a blog, portfolio, or online textbook.

Notes are written in [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published with GitHub Pages.
